question: Who was selected as the ‘Best Male Athlete’ in the National Games-2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sajan Prakash**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Sajan Prakash, **a 29-year-old swimmer from Kerala,** **was named the best male athlete at the 36th National Games in 2022.**
 
• The **2022 National Games was held in Gujarat and featured over 8,000 athletes from all 36 states and Union Territories.**
 
• The games' **motto **was Judega India, Jitega India. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The 36th National Games were held in 2022 in the state of Gujarat.
 
• Gujarat hosted the National Games for the first time in its history.
 
• The games were held in various cities across the state, including Ahmedabad, Gandhinagar, and Surat.
 
• The National Games is a biennial multi-sport event in which athletes from different states of India participate.
 
• The event is organized by the Indian Olympic Association (IOA).
 
• The 36th National Games were originally scheduled to be held in 2021 but were postponed multiple times due to various reasons, including infrastructure issues and financial problems.
 
• Haryana, Karnataka, and Maharashtra were the other options, but they did not host the 36th National Games.
 
• However, Haryana has hosted the National Games four times in the past, Karnataka has hosted twice, and Maharashtra has hosted once.
